component.name: Gyro
component.summary: Fast, modern YouTube Music client with lyrics and SPIN Mode

description.p: Gyro is a fast, privacy-first YouTube Music desktop client built with Rust, Tauri, and Svelte. Enjoy distraction-free music streaming with synced karaoke lyrics, offline downloads, local playlists, dual-deck crossfade, and collaborative SPIN listening rooms.

ul.li: Synced karaoke lyrics with shareable lyrics cards
Local playlists, favorites, listening stats, and offline downloads
Dual-deck crossfade, 5-band equalizer, and loudness normalization
SPIN Mode for real-time collaborative listening sessions
MPRIS media controls and system tray integration

screenshot.caption: Home screen in dark mode with quick picks and player sidebar
Local playlist view with suggestions and offline downloads
Party Mode with full-screen synced karaoke lyrics

description.p: Rebranded application to Gyro, added Linux AppStream and desktop metadata, and hardened Linux tray initialization.
YouTube Music–style playlist suggestions, native lyrics card & backup export, contiguous lyrics selection, and frontend performance improvements.
